about_the_game:
STELLAR DRIFT is a multiplayer, physics based, spaceship building game with roguelike elements. It takes place on "The Drift". A procedurally generated field in space riddled with precious metals, mining companies, outlaws, and various factions working to assert their dominance. 

DESIGN AND EQUIP YOUR SHIPS to thrive on The Drift. Every active component of your ship can be conveniently mapped to specific keys giving you complete control as the pilot. Find hundreds of parts though missions or loot them off of your un-alived enemies. Recruit crew members and synergize your ships parts to overwhelm other factions trying to assert their dominance on the drift.

ENEMIES AND FACTIONS on the drift are ever evolving. If left unchecked enemies can form groups and upgrade to elite or even boss status. Factions gather recourses and claim regions advantageous for their growth. Strategize when and where to focus your efforts, when to fight or run, and who to befriend or sabotage.
